description: This file declares an interface class INeedMediaDataThread within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. The interface defines two pure virtual methods, queueEvent() and stop(), for managing media data thread operations. It also includes standard constructor and destructor declarations, and deletes copy/move constructors and assignment operators to prevent copying or moving instances.

classes.name: INeedMediaDataThread
classes.description: An interface class that provides methods for queueing events and stopping a media data thread within the Rialto server component.

methods.name: queueEvent
methods.description: Pure virtual method to enqueue a media data event.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Pure virtual method to stop the media data thread.
